plan.scope: Only measured workloads; no universal speed claim

scope: Forced routing decisions, fixed synthetic text, batch one on one T4. Full path includes prefill, speculative state/copy/selection and generation; excludes model loading, Python garbage collection and allocator cache clearing. No router cost or attack efficacy is measured. No universal latency or memory claim.
pairing: Shuffle four modes within each whole repetition with the fixed seed. Three warmups per mode at each length are retained separately. The two paired comparisons are forced_accept/original and forced_reject/identical_decision_filtering.
uncertainty: Resample 20 paired repetition ratios with replacement, report median and 2.5/97.5 nearest-rank percentiles over 10000 bootstrap draws per comparison. This does not capture across-device/run variability.
